name: Akifumi
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Suzaku of Earth for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Retired Emperor (father), mother (deceased), Emperor (older brother), Motomi (older half-brother)
Occupation: Heir apparent of the Imperial Throne
Innate Element: Earth
Weapon(s): Kaiken (dagger for self-defense)
Specialties: Creating and wearing new perfumes
Hobbies: Reading (recently likes history books)
Habit(s): Gazing into people's eyes and faces
Favorite Scent: Kikka
Favorite Color: Mushiguri (light yellow-orange)
Favorite Flower(s): Chrysanthemum (autumn) / Christmas camellia (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
